## What and why

## How I checked it
- [ ] `uv run pytest -q` passes
- [ ] I added or updated tests (a bug fix has a regression test that fails without the fix)
- [ ] UI change: I ran the app and looked at it (screenshot attached)

## Checklist
- [ ] My commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] New source files start with `# SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-or-later`
- [ ] User-visible change: a line under `## [Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] No secrets, personal data or real library content in the diff
- [ ] New dependency or external data source: added to `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` / `docs/legal/DATA_SOURCES.md`, licence checked
- [ ] No DRM circumvention, and no book file is moved, deleted or overwritten
